title: Crypt
summary: Rust escrow template and offline CLI for encrypted secret sales on Ootle. A dispute reveals the secret publicly; the contract compares delivery with the seller’s commitment, not its value. Source reviewed October 13, 2026; no hosted client or release was linked in the reviewed repository. Creator test and security-review claims were not independently reproduced. The README’s historical “Stealth XTM” wording refers to native Ootle TARI mechanisms.
cardSummary: Explore encrypted secret sales with escrow and contract-settled delivery disputes.
creator: Og.boy
